mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM distribution_order do JOIN order_main om ON om.order_id = do.source_order_id AND om.camp_id = do.camp_id LEFT JOIN room_category rc ON rc.room_category_id = om.room_category_id

SELECT COALESCE(om.out_order_no, om.order_no, CAST(om.order_id AS CHAR)) AS orderNo, om.guest_name AS customerName, om.guest_mobile AS customerPhone, rc.name AS roomCategoryName, DATE_FORMAT(om.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS bookedTime, COALESCE(om.total_pay_price_cent, om.total_price_cent, 0) AS invoicePriceCent, COALESCE(do.commission_price_cent, om.distribution_commission_cent, om.commission_price_cent, 0) AS commissionCent, CASE WHEN om.settlement_amount_cent > 0 THEN om.settlement_amount_cent ELSE GREATEST( COALESCE(om.total_pay_price_cent, om.total_price_cent, 0) - COALESCE(do.commission_price_cent, om.distribution_commission_cent, om.commission_price_cent, 0), 0 ) END AS incomePriceCent, CASE WHEN do.settlement_status = 'settled' THEN CASE WHEN om.settlement_amount_cent > 0 THEN om.settlement_amount_cent ELSE GREATEST( COALESCE(om.total_pay_price_cent, om.total_price_cent, 0) - COALESCE(do.commission_price_cent, om.distribution_commission_cent, om.commission_price_cent, 0), 0 ) END ELSE 0 END AS settledPriceCent, do.settlement_status AS settledState, CASE WHEN COALESCE(TRIM(om.remark), '') = '置换订单' THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS breakTemp FROM distribution_order do JOIN order_main om ON om.order_id = do.source_order_id AND om.camp_id = do.camp_id LEFT JOIN room_category rc ON rc.room_category_id = om.room_category_id
ORDER BY om.created_at ASC, om.order_id ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
SELECT c.name FROM pms_camp c WHERE c.camp_id = #{campId} AND c.is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
